summary: SOBR Safe filed a routine 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing logistics for its 2026 Annual Meeting, to be held Monday, November 2, 2026, with a record date of September 23, 2026. The board set a deadline of October 2, 2026 for Rule 14a-8 stockholder proposals and October 3, 2026 for universal-proxy director nominations under Rule 14a-19. No transactional, strategic, or governance-change event is reported; this is a calendar notice with no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation on any transaction.
